title: Situation Update: four-minute dip on chlorine analyzer AIT-301

fields.headline: AIT-301 dipped from 1.4 to 0.7 mg/L for four minutes
fields.narration: At 09:28 the finished-water chlorine analyzer AIT-301 on MBW-HMI-01 dropped from 1.4 to 0.7 mg/L, held for four minutes and came back to 1.4. No other analyzer moved. With LIMS (MBW-LIMS-01) down, the lab cannot look up whether any work was scheduled on the analyzer this morning.
keyFacts: AIT-302 (pH), AIT-303 (fluoride) and AIT-304 (turbidity) did not change
The lab’s calibration schedule is in LIMS, which is unavailable
fields.expectedAction: The Water Quality Manager orders a grab sample at the Clearwell 1 outlet, records it on the paper bench sheet and checks the paper calibration log; the IC does not change the plant’s mode on this reading alone.
fields.facilitatorNote: Red herring: the lab technician was doing the Monday calibration on AIT-301. If asked, the grab sample reads 1.4 mg/L and the paper log in the lab shows the calibration. Do not volunteer it.

snapshot.title: RTU-03 Telemetry Loss — Zone 3 Isolation

fields.headline: RTU-03 Telemetry Loss Confirmed
fields.narration: The Plant Superintendent, Ray Castellano, stands at the control room console. He taps the HMI screen, but the Zone 3 telemetry feed remains unresponsive. 'I’ve reviewed the HMI and all chemical feed pumps are still running. No alarms have triggered. The PLCs are not showing any fault states. The SCADA server (MBW-SCADA-SRV01) is online. I don’t see any reason to go to manual mode yet. But the telemetry loss on RTU-03 is real. We’re not getting any updates from Zone 3, and the lab is down. I’m worried we’re not seeing the full picture.'
keyFacts: RTU-03 remains offline with no data updates
All chemical feed pumps are still running
No SCADA alarms have triggered on the HMI
The lab in Zone 3 has not confirmed water quality
fields.expectedAction: Ops confirms that the control system is still running, but that telemetry has failed on a critical remote site; instructs Ray Castellano to begin manual site verification in Zone 3 and to monitor for any signs of overfeed or pressure drop below 15 psi; orders the SCADA / IT Security Manager (it) to begin forensic analysis on MBW-JUMP-01 and MBW-BKP-01.
fields.facilitatorNote: Read the narration with a tone of cautious urgency. The plant superintendent is confident in the system, but the lack of data is a growing concern. Watch for hesitation in the IC’s response to manual verification.
fields.scenarioTitle: Ransomware Riptide — SCADA Isolation & Public Trust

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the operational friction from I-01 and I-02. The system appears stable, but telemetry loss is confirmed. The IC must now decide whether to isolate Zone 3 or maintain automated operation. The IT team must begin forensic work on the jump host and backup server.
